sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- visit + agenda, carried] Zelenskyy pays a working visit to Turkiye Oct 31 at Erdogan's invitation; Istanbul talks cover bilateral cooperation, Russia's war and Black Sea security; Erdogan to host at Dolmabahce office, followed by a news conference (Turkish presidency via Turkiye Today). Zelenskyy (Oct 30 address): 'important negotiations' in Turkey; expects November formats 'under discussion for a long time'; hopes for a Ukraine-Russia-US trilateral in Abu Dhabi Nov 6-10. NO outcome, joint statement or press-conference readout located in the 12:00-13:00 window.
sections.what_verified: Visit/agenda: Turkish presidency (T1, STATE TR via Anadolu/TRT family logic -- recorded as official statement) + Kyiv Independent (T2) + Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA) + Ukrainska Pravda -- ≥2 families for the visit itself.
sections.what_disputed: DATE DISCREPANCY (flagged, not resolved): Vietnam.vn's Oct 31 piece says Duran stated Zelenskyy will meet Erdogan on 'November 1st' in Istanbul, against the Turkish presidency's Oct 31 date carried by every other outlet. Treat Oct 31 as the announced date (primary source) and Nov 1 as a single-relay discrepancy to watch at the next check. Also: US State Dept approval of 500 PAC-3 interceptors ($2.1bn, via Canada/Germany/Norway + EU funding, JUMPSTART) is a separate Oct 30 item, not an Istanbul outcome -- do not merge.
